gloss: to peel; to shell; to husk

definitions.gloss: to peel; to shell; to husk; to remove the shell/skin
definitions.explanation: To remove the outer covering of eggs, nuts, shellfish, or other foods with a hard outer layer.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゆで{卵|たまご}→ゆで卵：10651_yudetamago⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{殻|から}をむく。
エビ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{殻|から}をむいて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧。
⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{殻|から}をむく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}→焼き栗：24146_yakiguri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Peeling chestnuts is hard work, but roasted chestnuts are delicious.

notes:
A common cooking expression. The verb むく means to peel or strip off, and ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧ refers to any hard outer covering — eggshells, nutshells, crustacean shells, etc.

WHAT CAN BE PEELED:
- ⟦ゆで{卵|たまご}→ゆで卵：10651_yudetamago⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧: boiled egg shell
- エビ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧: shrimp shell
- ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧: chestnut shell
- ⟦{落花生|らっかせい}→落花生：21198_rakkasei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧: peanut shell
- ⟦{貝|かい}→貝：02145_kai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧: shellfish shell

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{皮|かわ}をむく→皮をむく：18103_kawawomuku⟧: to peel skin (of fruit, vegetables) — for soft outer layers
- ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧: to crack a shell — when breaking rather than peeling
- ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove the shell — more general

SIMILAR WORDS:
- むく: to peel — the base verb, used with various objects
- ⟦{皮|かわ}をむく→皮をむく：18103_kawawomuku⟧: to peel (fruit/vegetables) — for soft coverings like apple skin
- ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧つき: with shell on, unshelled — describes food still in its shell
